raw_evidence.context: The University and École Supérieure des Technologies Industrielles Avancées (ESTIA) have maintained a partnership since 1987 when Salford was chosen as the site of the UK’s National Advanced Robotics Research Centre. Today, the partnership has developed on the basis of a collaborative approach to both teaching and research; offering a unique opportunity for postgraduate students with an interest in engineering to learn from experts at two leading institutions in the areas of robotics, automation and systems engineering. The partnership is open to all ESTIA students who are interested in pursuing MSc Robotics and Automation following their first Master’s at ESTIA (Master’s 1). To find out more about the partnership, and how to apply, please contact Amélie Hacala, Admissions Officer via email: a.hacala@estia.fr . Institute Polytechnique des Sciences Avancées

We offer a number of international exchange opportunities. This enables our students to study from one semesters to an entire year at one of our partner institutions internationally. International Agents If you an international agent and are interested in working with the University of Salford to recruit students on our behalf, please email salford-international@salford.ac.uk . Visit us

If you would like to visit us to discuss opportunities for collaboration, please fill in our visitor request form . This should be completed at least 21 days before the date of your proposed visit. This enables us to ensure that you will receive the maximum benefit during your time here. Speak to our team If you have a general enquiry, please email academic-partnerships@salford.ac.uk . Alternatively, you can call us on +44 (0)161 295 5203 . Our phone line operating hours are 09:30-16:00, Monday to Friday. If calling us outside of these times please leave a voicemail and we will get back to you as soon as possible. #WeAreInternational
